7-Day Integrity Reset.

A daily email series that teaches you to regulate your nervous system and show up as the dad and leader you want to be. One email per day. One action per day. Seven days to prove you can change your state.

Get Your Reset

Fill in your details below and we'll send you the welcome email. Reply to confirm you're in, and your 7-day journey begins.

You'll receive one email per day for 7 days. This is a reply-based series — you only advance by taking action. You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time.

How It Works.

1

You Opt In

Fill the form and submit. You'll receive a welcome email within 2 minutes of hitting 'Send me the Reset'.

2

You Commit

Reply to the welcome email with "I'm in" to confirm you're committed. You have 30 minutes. This is your first act of integrity.

3

Daily Emails Arrive

For 7 days, you receive one email per day. Each contains a tool designed to regulate your nervous system and help you show up present.

4

You Take Action

After you complete each day's work, reply "COMPLETE" to unlock the next day. No reply, no progress.

5

If You Miss a Day

Reply "MISSED" and you'll restart from Day 1. No judgment. The tools are designed to compound, so restarting is part of the process.

6

You Complete All 7 Days

After finishing Day 7, you've proven to yourself that you can consciously change your state. You've earned a respectfully earned conversation about the next steps.

7

The Conversation

Reply "Let's chat" and you'll receive access to my booking calendar. We'll discuss what comes next based on where you are in your journey.

What You Need to Know.

Reply-Based

This isn't a passive email series. You only advance by replying. It's designed to filter for people who are serious about change.

Action Over Consumption

Reading the email isn't enough. You have to do the work, then reply to confirm. That's where the real change happens.

Commitment Matters

If you don't reply "I'm in" within 30 minutes, the series ends. This filters for people who are ready to commit.

Restart Anytime

If you miss a day, reply "MISSED" and start over from Day 1. The tools compound, so restarting is part of the journey.

Seven Days to Prove It

By Day 7, you'll have proof that you can regulate your nervous system on purpose. That's the foundation for everything that follows.

Earned Conversation

Completing all 7 days earns you a conversation about the next steps. No pitch. Just a respectful discussion about what's possible for you.

Change Your State. Choose How You Show Up.

Seven days. Seven tools. One clear mission: prove to yourself that you can regulate your nervous system on purpose, and show up as the dad and leader your family and business actually need.
